judgment.notes: There are no E/M applications in the authored inference. N005 is instantiated on exactly the packet's K,V(K),I and supplies both the chosen basis and the implication from x,y-invariance to all coordinate-unit invariances. L1 supplies that premise. The two routine background applications are separately verified: basis expansion uses finite I and the K-module structure; basis nonvanishing uses the nontrivial scalar field, not a presumed nonzero V(K).

S001 correctly obtains 0∈I from H003, a nonzero β_0 and hence F003 (BG002). For W≠{0}, subspace membership of 0 and extensionality give a nonzero w; its finite basis expansion (BG001) cannot have every coefficient zero. S002 uses the actual coordinate-unit meaning to obtain T_ij w=c_j β_i∈W. Since K is a field and c_j≠0, scalar closure yields every β_i∈W; expanding any vector then yields W=V(K). S003 combines F002/F003, and the induced representation supplied by N005 makes invariance under x,y,h equivalent to invariance under their K-span. Bracket closure of the integer span follows by bilinearity and H004's integral Chevalley constants. No distinct h-eigenvalues or algebraic closure is required. The one-index λ=0 case and λ=0,1 when p=2 cause no exceptional division in this local proof.
